original_benchmark.notes: 200 interactive web-app bug-discovery tasks; agentic browser verifier (Codex + gpt-5.6-luna by default) runs one target and one preservation workflow per task. Runner 96f86f2, dataset revision f10cd68. Two tasks (sweeper-045, sweeper-150) have reference fixes that fail upstream's own reference phase.

harbor_adapter.notes: 198 of 200 tasks adapted; sweeper-045 and sweeper-150 excluded because the upstream reference fix fails their target workflow on the original runner too. Oracle 198/198 at adapter commit 65d790a. Parity: Gemini CLI 0.60.0 + gemini-3.8-flash (Vertex AI) on a fixed 10-task cohort, three runs per side, identical verifier (Codex + gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh): original 20.00 +/- 5.77, Harbor 23.33 +/- 6.67 solved rate.
